text:
jia: starting onboarding run for orca13b-v2 (int4) — saw an OOM on canary with batch=4, max_new_tokens=1024. logs below.

mike: ouch, paste logs?

jia: ```
[2024-09-12 10:02:13] ERROR runtime: OOM while allocating 1.2 GiB for KV cache (seq_len=2048, max_new=1024)
stack: serve/worker.go:212 -> runtime/kv_cache.go:88 -> alloc.go:47
```

sofia: hmm seq_len 2048 + max_new 1024 = big. what's default warmup/kvcache policy?

jia: default kvcache=enabled, prefetch=on, slot_reserve=0.1, batching=continuous

leo: quick ideas: 1) lower default max_new_tokens to 256 for orca13b-v2 canary, 2) enable kv-trim on prefault, 3) try batch_pacing=0.75 or reduce batch_size to 2

mike: + try compile flags: --use-fast-attn and disable prefetch for long-seq workloads

sofia: any perf hit numbers? we need SLO tradeoffs.

jia: baseline (no changes) p95=180ms for short prompts, but for long seqs we hit OOM 6% and latency spikes 600ms when fallback occurs

leo: propose rapid patch: set per-model defaults: max_new_tokens=256, kv_trim_threshold=0.6, slot_reserve=0.2. deploy to canary group only.

ci-bot: deploy queued: /deploy model=orca13b-v2@canary config={'max_new_tokens':256,'kv_trim':0.6,'slot_reserve':0.2}

mike: after patch run: canary 1 hour in shows OOMs -> 0, p95 for long prompts down to 260ms, token throughput -12% but stable :thumbsup:

sofia: good. next: run quant int4 quality sweep; if quality regresses we fallback to int8 for high-alert routes.

jia: I'll open an evalbench with 2k-long prompts + typical chat set. assign to me and mike.

mike: ack. I'll follow up with perf numbers in #benchmarks later.

leo: add runbook note: if OOMs reappear, set prefetch=off and enable early-fallback -> fallback_model=orca13b-v1

jia: adding to onboarding PR now: https://git.company/repo/PR-482

sofia: nice work. :rocket:
